outcome: Inter-rater reliability of the Parent Programme Implementation Checklist (PPIC)
Intra-rater reliability of the Parent Programme Implementation Checklist (PPIC)
cohort: The study involved initial data obtained during the delivery of the Incredible Years BASIC programme across nine localities in England and Wales.
finding: The Parent Programme Implementation Checklist (PPIC) achieved reasonable levels of inter-rater reliability (percentage agreements >70%, ICC range 0.404-0.730) across its subscales and total score, and acceptable intra-rater reliability at the subscale level.
